sections.title: DRAMA! From Page to Stage
sections.description: This course will center on the question: How does one read and interpret a play? And how might the written page be translated—and transported—to the stage? The class will engage with a wide range of dramatic material, through readings, viewings of both live and recorded productions, and potentially the performances of selected pieces. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
